_comment: SerpApi has no car rental engine, so this is data rather than a lookup. The rules object is the point of the file: the under-25 surcharge and the age floors are a real cost that every other travel site hides in a footnote, and this cohort is mostly 19 to 24. Rates carry source 'authored' until a real agency quote replaces them; the rules carry 'operator' because they were read off the agency's own page. Only 'compact' is listed because only 'compact' has a figure — an invented midsize rate would be worse than an absent one.

youngDriverFee.label: Under-25 young driver fee
youngDriverFee.note: Enterprise states "approximately $25.00 per day", varying by location. Verified as a fact, soft as a figure. Applies to ages 21 to 24.

los-angeles.note: No major agency in California rents to under-21s. Enterprise and Avis both set the floor at 21, and only Hertz will consider a 20-year-old. A foreign licence is accepted at all three, but a debit card usually is not — the deposit hold needs a credit card in the driver's own name, which is the thing that actually stops most of this cohort.

compact.label: Compact hire
compact.note: A Friday-to-Sunday weekend is three hire days, not two. Splits across the group. Collected by hand; it was previously carried at four slightly different rates per destination with no sourced reason for the difference, so it is one rate until a real quote replaces it.
